# Data Analsysis
## Import data
```{r}
load("data/SSB_LAI.Rdata")
```

# Change-points
## Identify change-points
```{r}
# Shetland / Orkney
### cpts analysis
ssbcpts <- cpt.mean(data = SSB_LAI$SSB_component[SSB_LAI$component == "Shetland_Orkney"], method = "BinSeg", Q = 6)
plot(ssbcpts, type = "l", cpt.col = "navyblue", xlab = "Index", pt.widt = 4)
cpts(ssbcpts)
SSB_LAI$year[SSB_LAI$component == "Shetland_Orkney"][c(12, 19, 23, 25, 34, 43)]
#### Index: 12,   19,   23,   25,   34,   43
#### Years: 1983, 1990, 1994, 1996, 2005, 2014

### bcp analysis
bcp.ssb <- bcp(SSB_LAI$SSB_component[SSB_LAI$component == "Shetland_Orkney"])
plot(bcp.ssb, main = "SSB")
which(bcp.ssb$posterior.prob >= 0.7)
SSB_LAI$year[SSB_LAI$component == "Shetland_Orkney"][c(12, 19, 23, 31, 34, 43)]
#### Index: 12,   19,   23,   31,   34,   43
#### Years: 1983, 1990, 1994, 2002, 2005, 2014

#### Changepoints detected by both methods +-1 year and min. 5 years between points:
#### 1983, 1990, 2005, 2014

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Buchan
### cpts analysis
ssbcpts <- cpt.mean(data = SSB_LAI$SSB_component[SSB_LAI$component == "Buchan"], method = "BinSeg", Q = 6)
plot(ssbcpts, type = "l", cpt.col = "navyblue", xlab = "Index", pt.widt = 4)
cpts(ssbcpts)
SSB_LAI$year[SSB_LAI$component == "Buchan"][c(15, 18, 22, 38, 40, 47)]
#### Index: 11,   18,   22,   38,   40,   47
#### Years: 1986, 1989, 1993, 2009, 2011, 2018

### bcp analysis
bcp.ssb <- bcp(SSB_LAI$SSB_component[SSB_LAI$component == "Buchan"])
plot(bcp.ssb, main = "SSB")
which(bcp.ssb$posterior.prob >= 0.7)
SSB_LAI$year[SSB_LAI$component == "Shetland_Orkney"][c(18, 30, 39, 47)]
#### Index: 18-23, 30,  39,   46-47
#### Years: 1989, 2001, 2010, 2018

#### Changepoints detected by both methods +-1 year and min. 5 years between points:
#### 1989, 2009, 2018

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Banks
### cpts analysis
ssbcpts <- cpt.mean(data = SSB_LAI$SSB_component[SSB_LAI$component == "Banks"], method = "BinSeg", Q = 6)
plot(ssbcpts, type = "l", cpt.col = "navyblue", xlab = "Index", pt.widt = 4)
cpts(ssbcpts)
SSB_LAI$year[SSB_LAI$component == "Banks"][c(11, 19, 29, 34, 38, 48)]
#### Index: 11,   19,   29,   34,   38,   48
#### Years: 1982, 1990, 2000, 2005, 2009, 2018

### bcp analysis
bcp.ssb <- bcp(SSB_LAI$SSB_component[SSB_LAI$component == "Banks"])
plot(bcp.ssb, main = "SSB")
which(bcp.ssb$posterior.prob >= 0.7)
SSB_LAI$year[SSB_LAI$component == "Banks"][c(12, 19, 29, 30, 34)]
#### Index: 12,   19,   29,   30,   34
#### Years: 1983, 1990, 2000, 2001, 2005

#### Changepoints detected by both methods +-1 year and min. 5 years between points:
#### 1982, 1990, 2000 nur BinSang 2018

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Downs
### cpts analysis
ssbcpts <- cpt.mean(data = SSB_LAI$SSB_component[SSB_LAI$component == "Downs"], method = "BinSeg", Q = 6)
plot(ssbcpts, type = "l", cpt.col = "navyblue", xlab = "Index", pt.widt = 4)
cpts(ssbcpts)
SSB_LAI$year[SSB_LAI$component == "Downs"][c(16, 28, 30, 40, 44, 50)]
#### Index: 16,   28,   30,   40,   44,   50
#### Years: 1987, 1999, 2001, 2011, 2015, 2021

### bcp analysis
bcp.ssb <- bcp(SSB_LAI$SSB_component[SSB_LAI$component == "Downs"])
plot(bcp.ssb, main = "SSB")
which(bcp.ssb$posterior.prob >= 0.7)
SSB_LAI$year[SSB_LAI$component == "Downs"][c(30, 40, 44)]
#### Index: 30,   40,   44,
#### Years: 2001, 2011, 2015

#### Changepoints detected by both methods +-1 year and min. 5 years between points:
#### 2001, 2011     nur BinSang 1987, 2021


```

## Plot SSB change points
```{r}
### Shetland Orkney
plot_SSB_cpt_SHOR <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = SSB_LAI[SSB_LAI$component == "Shetland_Orkney", ], 
              changepoints = c(1983, 1990, 2005, 2014),
              component = "Shetland / Orkney", 
              SSB_column = "SSB_component", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd_component", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component",
              show_hlines = FALSE)
plot_SSB_cpt_SHOR

### Buchan
plot_SSB_cpt_Buchan <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = SSB_LAI[SSB_LAI$component == "Buchan", ], 
              changepoints = c(1989, 2009, 2018),
              component = "Buchan", 
              SSB_column = "SSB_component", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd_component", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component", 
              show_hlines = FALSE)
plot_SSB_cpt_Buchan

### Banks
plot_SSB_cpt_Banks <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = SSB_LAI[SSB_LAI$component == "Banks", ], 
              changepoints = c(1982, 1990, 2000, 2018),
              ribbon_colors = c("steelblue", "orange", "purple", "lightgreen", "grey"),
              vline_colors = c("black", "black", "black", "grey"),
              component = "Banks", 
              SSB_column = "SSB_component", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd_component", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component", 
              show_hlines = FALSE)
plot_SSB_cpt_Banks

### Downs
plot_SSB_cpt_Downs <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = SSB_LAI[SSB_LAI$component == "Downs", ], 
              changepoints = c(1987, 2001, 2011, 2021),
              ribbon_colors = c("grey", "steelblue", "orange", "purple", "grey"),
              vline_colors = c("grey", "black", "black","grey"),
              component = "Downs", 
              SSB_column = "SSB_component", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd_component", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component", 
              show_hlines = FALSE)
plot_SSB_cpt_Downs
```

### Save plots
```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_components.png"),
       plot = gridExtra::grid.arrange(plot_SSB_cpt_SHOR, 
                                      plot_SSB_cpt_Buchan, 
                                      plot_SSB_cpt_Banks, 
                                      plot_SSB_cpt_Downs, ncol = 2),
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```
